annotations.bnjettag.io/readout: epoch-500 snapshots under /data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-c-20261002: certify_ebops.py, analysis/attn_entropy.py, monitor_c.py

args:
set -euo pipefail
export KERAS_BACKEND=tensorflow MPLBACKEND=Agg TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=2 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
mkdir -p /work/code
echo '6919462cf050c5dca664baec694f36081f05d8c4075a0d299b28af8ce4eb9da3  /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf /cmcode/hgq2.tar.gz -C /work/code --strip-components=1
export PYTHONPATH=/work/code
export BNJ_DATA_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926 BNJ_RUN_ROOT=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-c-20261002 BNJ_CAMPAIGN_DIR=/work/code/campaigns/chang1002c
export BNJ_STAGE=pilot-c
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 WANDB_MODE=disabled
pip install -q --no-cache-dir -r /work/code/requirements-cpu.txt
cd /work/code
MSHA=$(python -c "import run_study; print(run_study.manifest()['sha256'])")
test "$MSHA" = "7ab48738fc4d916ad2b8398b1d35a6076413013d8af33b9a69afcd941a60544f" || { echo "MANIFEST_SHA_MISMATCH $MSHA"; exit 1; }
echo "MANIFEST_SHA_OK $MSHA"
export BNHGQ2_CODE_SHA256="$MSHA"
OUT=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-c-20261002/readout-epoch-0500-691946-r1
test ! -e "$OUT" || { echo "READOUT_OUTPUT_EXISTS $OUT"; exit 1; }
ONLY=""; IDX=""; NSNAP=0; MISSING=""
for pair in 0:chang1002c-a-n64-s1 1:chang1002c-a-n64-s2 24:chang1002c-d-n64-s1 57:chang1002c-e1-n64-s1 48:chang1002c-a07-350-n64-s1 16:chang1002c-c-n64-s1 32:chang1002c-f-n64-s1 56:chang1002c-cprime-n64-s1; do
  i=${pair%%:*}; n=${pair#*:}; d=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-c-20261002/runs/$n
  if test -f "$d/snapshots/epoch-0500/state.json"; then ONLY="$ONLY${ONLY:+,}$n"; IDX="$IDX $i"; NSNAP=$((NSNAP + 1))
  elif test -f "$d/DIVERGED.json"; then ONLY="$ONLY${ONLY:+,}$n"; IDX="$IDX $i"
  else why=NO_TERMINAL_MARKER; test -f "$d/RSS_GATE_FAIL.json" && why=RSS_GATE_FAIL; echo "READOUT_MISSING $n $why"; MISSING="$MISSING $n"; fi
done
test "$NSNAP" -gt 0 || { echo "READOUT_NOTHING_PRESENT"; exit 1; }
test -f /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data/READY.json || { echo "CACHE_NOT_READY"; exit 1; }
mkdir "$OUT"
echo "READOUT_ARMS only=$ONLY indices=$IDX missing=${MISSING:- none}"
CERT=0; A26=0; MONC=0
python -u /work/code/campaigns/chang1002c/certify_ebops.py --run-root /data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-c-20261002/runs --cache /data/chang-n64-20260926/n64/data --out "$OUT/certify-snapshot-0500.json" --snapshot 500 --only "$ONLY" || CERT=$?
python -u /work/code/analysis/attn_entropy.py --indices $IDX --epoch 500 --out "$OUT/a26-entropy-epoch-0500.json" || A26=$?
for n in $(echo "$ONLY" | tr , " "); do
  t=/data/chang-n64-20260926/pilot-c-20261002/runs/$n/snapshots/epoch-0500/pid_telemetry.jsonl
  if test -s "$t"; then python -u /work/code/campaigns/chang1002c/monitor_c.py --config /work/code/campaigns/chang1002c/configs/$n.json --telemetry "$t" --json "$OUT/controller-$n.json" || MONC=1; else echo "TELEMETRY_MISSING $n"; MONC=1; fi
done
sha256sum "$OUT"/*.json
echo "READOUT_JOB_DONE certify_exit=$CERT a26_exit=$A26 controller_exit=$MONC missing=${MISSING:- none}"
test "$CERT" = 0 && test "$A26" = 0 && test "$MONC" = 0 && test -z "$MISSING"
containers.name: main
